title: 3 December
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj ordains 56 youths as sadhus in Ahmedabad
story: On this day in 1973, on his 53rd birthday, Pramukh Swami Maharaj ordained 56 youths as sadhus as kalashes were placed on Shahibaug Mandir.

items.text:
Pramukh Swami Maharaj ordains
56 youths as sadhus in Ahmedabad

On the occasion of the 53rd birth celebrations of Pramukh Swami Maharaj in Ahmedabad,
the kalashes were placed on top of the shikhars of BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in
Shahibaug, Ahmedabad. On this day, Pramukh Swami Maharaj ordained 56 youths as sadhus.

options.headline: Akshar Purnima 2017 in Jaipur
options.story:
"My food"

Today, after breakfast, Mahant Swami Maharaj said to the attendant sadhu, "My food...!"

The attendant sadhu could not understand. Swamishri said again, "My food!"

Still not catching on, the attendant sadhu asked, "What, Swami!?"

Every day after breakfast the virtues of the sadhus are spoken of, and referring to this, with a slight air of "Don't you understand?", Swamishri said, "Imbibing virtues!"

Usually the virtues of others burn people's hearts, but in Swamishri's mind the virtues of others are his food.

Showers flower petals on Shri Harikrishna Maharaj to celebrate 'fulo ki holi'. Performs morning arti. Performs his morning puja. Greets all with Jai Swaminarayan. Performs evening arti. Blesses the evening satsang assembly. Engrossed in darshan of Shri Nilkanth Varni. Showers flower petals on Pujya Viveksagar Swami. Engrossed in darshan of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Aksharbrahman Gunatitanand Swami. Greets all with 'Jai Swaminarayan'. Showers flower petals on Shri Harikrishna Maharaj to celebrate 'fulo ki holi'. Honored with a shower of flower petals. Sanctifies murtis for ghar mandirs. Performs pratishtha arti. Showers flower petals on Shri Nilkanth Varni. Engrossed in darshan of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Radha-Govind Dev. Performs pratishtha rituals of murtis. Performs abhishek of Shri Nilkanth Varni. Performs pratishtha rituals of murtis for BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Dausa, Rajasthan, India. Offers thal to Shri Guru Parampara. Engrossed in darshan of Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. Gives darshan to bhaktas. Shri Harikrishna Maharaj in Bapa's morning puja. Sadhus shower flower petals on bhaktas.

options.headline: Inauguration of Satsang Diksha Scripture Transcribed into Braille, Nenpur, India
options.story:
His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj wrote the ‘Satsang Diksha’ scripture in Gujarati and has expressed his wish to make it available for all so that everyone can benefit from its message and guidance. The original Gujarati text was first rendered into Sanskrit. Thereafter it has been translated into Hindi, English, Marathi, Punjabi, Swahili and seven European languages: French, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, Polish and Russian.

Translations into other languages are in progress and will help devotees worldwide. For the benefit of the visually challenged, two braille versions have been prepared. One is by the respected CNIB Foundation (formerly known as Canadian National Institute for the Blind) in Toronto.

The Foundation generously and enthusiastically undertook the task to transcribe the scripture into English Braille. The other is by Vision Australia. The first copies of these historic publications were blessed and inaugurated by His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj in Nenpur, Gujarat, India, on Thursday, 3 December 2020.

The BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha sincerely appreciates the wholehearted efforts and support of the CNIB and Vision Australia in making the ‘Satsang Diksha’ scripture available to those with visual difficulties. Executive Director of the CNIB, Suzanne Decary-van den Broek, said, “CNIB welcomed the opportunity to support BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha in creating an accessible braille version of one of their scriptures.

As an organization dedicated to transforming our communities into beacons of accessibility and inclusion, braille remains an essential tool to independence for people who are blind or partially sighted. It opens the door to literacy, access to information, equality, education and employment.

While technology can level the playing field for people with sight loss, it isn’t always an appropriate or available option. The scripture is a perfect example of something that should be available for people to access whenever and however they choose.” The Satsang Diksha in braille printed by CNIB is available through the Centre for Equitable Library Access for registered members who would like to read the scripture.

Individuals can also request copies through their local libraries within Canada.

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj consecrates the murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Ghanshyam Maharaj, Harikrishna Maharaj, Laxminarayan Dev, Hanumanji, Ganapatiji and marble murtis of Guru Parampara amidst Vedic rituals
options.story:
Swamishri consecrated the murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Ghanshyam Maharaj, Harikrishna Maharaj, Laxminarayan Dev, Hanumanji, Ganapatiji and marble murtis of Guru Parampara amidst Vedic rituals. The inauguration of the Shree Swaminarayan Mandir in Anand was a historic event because the devotees of Anand in the time of Shastriji Maharaj were the pillars of BAPS. The murti pratishtha assembly was at the Swaminarayan Nagar. ( see special report )

In the evening, from 7.00 pm to 8.30 pm the APC (Akshar Purushottam Chhatralaya) Ex-students Convention was held in the presence of Swamishri. Finally, the students honored the murti of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj.

Swamishri blessed 20 youths who had jogged with a torch from Limdi to Vidyanagar (148 kms) and youths who had cycled from Surendranagar to Vidyanagar (78 kms) on the occasion of Swamishri's 80th birthday celebration.

Performs the murti pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj in Anand. Bapa with the newly initiated sadhus and parshads. Performed the arti during the yagna for World Peace. Bapa and Thakorji arrive on a decorated float amidst a sea of bhaktas to the main evening birthday assembly celebration. Offers tulsi leaves to Lord Harikrishna Maharaj. Blesses the procession from the mandir in Anand. Shri L.K. Advani, Home Minister of India, and Bapa inaugurates the BAPS Residential School for Girls, Karamsad. Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Laxminarayan Dev fabulously attired after the consecration ceremony. Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj. Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. In a warm, festive ambience Bapa performs puja of Thakorji on his 80th birthday celebratioin. A sight for the gods: Arti being performed by nearly 175,000 bhaktas during the celebration assembly.

3 December 2000 dawned with the auspicious chanting of Vedic mantras at the newly built Swaminaryan Mandir in Anand. The murti pratishtha ceremony was performed by Swamishri amidst euphoria and divinity. The occasion was all the more significant because the town of Anand prides in playing a pivotal role in the development of the Akshar Purushottam Sanstha. Swamishri consecrated the murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Ghanshyam Maharaj, Laxminarayan Dev, Hanumanji, Ganapatiji and Guru Parampara. The 65 ft high, 104 ft long and 75 ft wide mandir will now breathe with 172 socio-spiritual activities of the BAPS.

items.text:
Pramukh Swami Maharaj ordains
56 youths as sadhus in Ahmedabad

On the occasion of the 53rd birth celebrations of Pramukh Swami Maharaj in Ahmedabad,
the kalashes were placed on top of the shikhars of BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in
Shahibaug, Ahmedabad. On this day, Pramukh Swami Maharaj ordained 56 youths as sadhus.
